PeekBox 只在你点击“检查更新…”时联网，不自动检查，不收集任何数据。: PeekBox connects to the internet only when you click “Check for Updates…”. It never checks automatically and collects no data.
一切就绪。在 Finder 中选中文件夹或压缩包，按空格即可预览。: All set. Select a folder or archive in Finder and press Space to preview it.
一次只能重命名一个项目: You can rename only one item at a time
一次最多打开 10 项: You can open up to 10 items at a time
不支持导入此项目（符号链接或特殊文件）：%@: This item cannot be imported (symbolic link or special file): %@
不能删除压缩包中的全部内容: You can’t delete everything in the archive
之后可以在废纸篓中选择“放回原处”恢复。: You can restore it later with “Put Back” in the Trash.
从压缩包中打开或拷贝的文件会先提取到缓存，其他应用打开的、剪贴板里的都是这份文件: Files opened or copied from an archive are first extracted to this cache. Other apps and the clipboard use these copies, so they aren’t deleted when the preview closes; instead, the background service removes expired ones when it starts. After clearing, such files still open in other apps may fail to save.
修改会直接保存到“%@”中。: The change is saved directly to “%@”.
修改压缩包时将旧版本移到废纸篓: Move Old Version to Trash When Modifying Archives
修改后的压缩包校验未通过，原压缩包未改动: The edited archive failed verification; the original archive is unchanged
分卷压缩包（%@）请在所在文件夹的预览中展开: To browse this multi-volume archive (%@), expand it from a preview of its folder
删除前的压缩包会放进废纸篓，需要时可以找回。: The archive as it was before the deletion goes to the Trash, so you can recover it if needed.
加密条目，输入密码后预览: Encrypted item. Enter the password to preview it.
压缩包中已有同名项目。替换会移除原有的“%@”及其全部内容。: An item with this name is already in the archive. Replacing it removes the existing “%@” and everything in it.
压缩包中已有同名项目。要用拖入的项目替换它吗？: An item with this name is already in the archive. Do you want to replace it with the one you’re adding?
压缩包中有重复路径，为避免损坏按只读处理: The archive contains duplicate paths, so it’s treated as read-only to avoid damage
压缩包内容已加密，输入密码后才能查看。: The archive’s contents are encrypted. Enter the password to view them.
压缩包在修改期间被其他程序更改，已放弃本次修改: The archive was changed by another app during the edit, so the change was discarded
压缩包已被其他程序修改，请关闭预览后重新打开: The archive was changed by another app. Close the preview and open it again.
压缩包或所在文件夹不可写: The archive or its folder isn’t writable
只支持删除 ZIP 压缩包内的项目: Deleting is supported only for items in ZIP archives
只支持重命名 ZIP 压缩包内的项目: Renaming is supported only for items in ZIP archives
只能修改 ZIP 压缩包: Only ZIP archives can be modified
只能修改本机内置磁盘上的压缩包（iCloud、网络与外置磁盘不支持原地修改）: Only archives on this Mac’s internal disk can be modified (iCloud, network and external disks aren’t supported)
只能拖入真实 ZIP 压缩包，嵌套压缩包只读: Drop into a ZIP file on disk. Nested archives are read-only.
可选。开启后可访问所有位置，不再逐项询问。: Optional. Grants access to all locations without asking for each one.
名称不能为空，也不能包含“/”: The name can’t be empty or contain “/”

后面还有 %lld 个同名项目，也这样处理.one: Do the same for the %lld remaining conflict
后面还有 %lld 个同名项目，也这样处理.other: Do the same for the %lld remaining conflicts

在压缩包内重命名、删除或替换后，修改前的压缩包会放进废纸篓，需要时可以找回。: After renaming, deleting or replacing items in an archive, its previous version is moved to the Trash so you can recover it.
在压缩包内重命名后，修改前的压缩包会放进废纸篓，需要时可以找回。: After renaming inside an archive, the previous version is moved to the Trash so you can recover it if needed.
在压缩包内重命名或删除后，修改前的压缩包会放进废纸篓，需要时可以找回。: After renaming or deleting inside an archive, the previous version is moved to the Trash so you can recover it if needed.
完成前请不要移动或修改这个压缩包。: Don’t move or change this archive until the operation finishes.
密码不正确，请重新拖出并输入密码: Incorrect password. Drag the item out again and enter the password.
将在“%@”中新建。: The folder will be created in “%@”.
将在“%@”的“%@”中新建。: The folder will be created in “%2$@” inside “%1$@”.
已取消，原压缩包未改动: Cancelled. The original archive was not changed.
已解锁，可以拖出: Unlocked. You can drag items out now.
所选项目已加密，输入密码后才能继续。: The selected items are encrypted. Enter the password to continue.
扩展在“系统设置 › 通用 › 登录项与扩展 › 快速查看”中启用。后台服务负责: Enable the extensions in System Settings › General › Login Items & Extensions › Quick Look. The background service handles opening, copying, extracting and moving to Trash; it runs only when needed and quits after about 30 seconds of inactivity.
拖出加密的项目前，请先输入密码。: Enter the password before dragging out encrypted items.
文件较大，不在此预览: This file is too large to preview here
暂不支持向加密 ZIP 添加内容: Adding content to encrypted ZIP archives is not supported yet

有 %lld 项未能删除（可能正被其他应用使用）.one: %lld item couldn’t be deleted (it may be in use by another app)
有 %lld 项未能删除（可能正被其他应用使用）.other: %lld items couldn’t be deleted (they may be in use by another app)

条目大小异常，压缩包可能已损坏: An entry has an invalid size; the archive may be damaged
条目较多，已停止自动展开: Too many items; stopped expanding automatically
检查时，尚未决定的位置会弹出系统授权提示。: Locations you haven’t decided on yet will show a system permission prompt.
此压缩包只读，不支持拖入: This archive is read-only and cannot accept files
此压缩包有 %@，超过设置的上限 %@，未自动读取。: This archive is %@, larger than the %@ limit, so it wasn’t read automatically.
此项目已加密，输入密码后即可预览。: This item is encrypted. Enter the password to preview it.
源文件在读取期间发生变化，已放弃导入：%@: The source file changed while being read. Import was abandoned: %@
磁盘可用空间不足，原压缩包未改动: Not enough disk space. The original archive was not changed.
自动展开最多读取约 5,000 项；加密、分卷压缩包不参与自动展开。: Auto-expand reads up to about 5,000 items. Encrypted and multi-volume archives are never auto-expanded.
设置窗口立即切换；预览窗口在下次打开时切换。: The Settings window switches immediately; previews switch the next time you open one.
超过上限的压缩包不会自动读取：单独预览时显示“仍然读取”按钮，在文件夹中也不参与: Archives over the limit aren’t read automatically: previewing one shows a “Read Anyway” button, and they’re skipped when auto-expanding folders.
还差几步：完成下面的准备工作后即可在 Finder 中按空格预览。: A few more steps: finish the setup below, then press Space in Finder to preview.
这是分卷的一部分，请预览第一卷 %@: This is part of a multi-volume archive. Preview the first volume, %@
这里设置的是全局默认值，与预览窗口左下角的快速设置同步，下次打开预览时生效。: These are global defaults, kept in sync with Quick Settings at the bottom left of the preview. Changes apply the next time you open a preview.
预览窗口本身只能读取被预览的项目。打开、拷贝、提取和移到废纸篓由 PeekBox: The preview itself can only read the item being previewed. Opening, copying, extracting and moving to Trash are done by the PeekBox background service, which needs your permission to access the protected locations below.
同一类文件有多个预览扩展时，由系统任选其一，PeekBox 可能不会生效。请在“: When several preview extensions handle the same kind of file, macOS picks one of them, so PeekBox may not be used. Turn these extensions off under “Quick Look”.
PeekBox 采用 GPL-3.0 许可。本应用及第三方组件的许可原文随应用附: PeekBox is licensed under GPL-3.0. License texts for the app and its third-party components are included with the app.
这是加密的磁盘镜像，暂不支持预览: This disk image is encrypted and can't be previewed yet
磁盘镜像数据损坏，无法提取: The disk image data is damaged and can't be extracted
“%@”中已有同名项目。替换会把原有的“%@”移到废纸篓。: An item with the same name already exists in “%1$@”. Replacing it moves the existing “%2$@” to the Trash.
